Players Committee card image of [[Rey, All Of The Jedi]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Once during your control phase, may search your Lost Pile and choose two cards; opponent places one out of play (retrieve the other). Once per game, may ▼ a lightsaber on Rey. Immune to attrition < 5.” Uploaded unchanged.
